scope: The TRACE-X multi-source investigative analytics application (CDR/IPDR, banking and social media), its Postgres system of record and Neo4j knowledge graph, and the evidence lifecycle from ingest through analysis to certified export.
out_of_scope: The deploying agency's corporate estate — email, end-user devices, network perimeter, physical premises and HR processes. Those controls are listed with owner 'agency' so the boundary is auditable, never silently omitted.
attestation: Generated by inspecting this running deployment. Controls marked 'manual' are unclaimed, not passing, and score zero. This is a self-assessment and is not an independent assurance opinion.

open_findings.name: MFA required for infrastructure access
open_findings.detail: The application performs no multi-factor authentication of its own.
observations: Stated plainly rather than deferred: the demo identity model is a bearer username, which is single-factor at best.
Remediation: front the API with the agency's identity provider and require MFA there.

open_findings.name: Unique production database authentication enforced
open_findings.description: Production databases use unique, non-default credentials.
open_findings.detail: The database is using the shipped development password.
observations: Reported as a gap rather than hidden: this is exactly the finding a compliance report exists to surface.
Override POSTGRES_PASSWORD and NEO4J_PASSWORD before any real deployment.

open_findings.name: Software development lifecycle established
open_findings.description: A documented SDLC governs changes to the software.

open_findings.name: Software supply chain risks monitored
open_findings.description: Third-party and open-source components are assessed.
open_findings.detail: No dependency manifest or lockfile found.

open_findings.name: Penetration testing performed within the last 12 months
open_findings.description: An independent penetration test is performed annually.
open_findings.detail: No penetration test has been performed against this application.
observations: Required before any deployment handling real evidence.

open_findings.name: Vulnerabilities scanned
open_findings.description: Systems, applications and repositories are scanned regularly.
open_findings.detail: No automated vulnerability scanning runs against this codebase or its images.
observations: Recorded as a gap rather than omitted. Remediation is routine: dependency audit plus image scanning in CI.
